mapping: synth_xilinx -family xc7; generic ram_bram model, not Vivado XPM
ram_model: build/karatsuba-integration/ram_bram_estimate.sv changes only the XPM preprocessor guard to select the original generic branch
vivado_status: NOT_RUN: no Vivado executable on this host

reproduction_commands.baseline-inv: read_slang --std 1800-2017 rtl/trike_inv_schedule_pkg.sv build/karatsuba-integration/ram_bram_estimate.sv build/karatsuba-integration/main.sv build/karatsuba-integration/inv.sv --top trike_poly_inv_core; synth_xilinx -family xc7 -top trike_poly_inv_core; tee -o build/karatsuba-integration/baseline-inv-synth/xilinx-stat.json stat -json
reproduction_commands.inplace-inv: read_slang --std 1800-2017 rtl/trike_inv_schedule_pkg.sv build/karatsuba-integration/ram_bram_estimate.sv rtl/trike_poly_mul_core.sv rtl/trike_poly_mul_karatsuba_core.sv rtl/trike_poly_inv_core.sv --top trike_poly_inv_core; synth_xilinx -family xc7 -top trike_poly_inv_core; tee -o build/karatsuba-integration/inplace-inv-synth/xilinx-stat.json stat -json
reproduction_commands.baseline-large-mul: read_slang --std 1800-2017 -G R_BITS=106781 build/karatsuba-integration/ram_bram_estimate.sv build/karatsuba-integration/main.sv --top trike_poly_mul_core; synth_xilinx -family xc7 -top trike_poly_mul_core; tee -o build/karatsuba-integration/baseline-large-mul-synth/xilinx-stat.json stat -json
reproduction_commands.inplace-large-mul: read_slang --std 1800-2017 -G R_BITS=106781 build/karatsuba-integration/ram_bram_estimate.sv rtl/trike_poly_mul_core.sv rtl/trike_poly_mul_karatsuba_core.sv --top trike_poly_mul_core; synth_xilinx -family xc7 -top trike_poly_mul_core; tee -o build/karatsuba-integration/inplace-large-mul-synth/xilinx-stat.json stat -json
